purpose: Teach: 多数決/同封/空席/値打ち/再選/内輪/詰め込み/関空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマ、本気で、絶対、多数決、絶対、ではなく、絶対、教授と、絶対、議論、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — don't just go with what wins a vote. Discuss it seriously with your professor. Make sure you really work through it together.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Measured tempo. The weight of expectation without pressure. A mentor laying down what matters, not demanding obedience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、同封、絶対、データ、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, understood. I've got all the paper data organized and ready. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Slight nod in the voice. Genuine appreciation, not performative. Quick, efficient — showing he's already moving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 教授会の、本気で、絶対、空席、絶対、補充、絶対、新研究者、絶対、推薦しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: There's a vacant position on the faculty committee. Recommend a new researcher for it. Make it happen.
lines.style: Sharp, authoritative opening. No negotiation in the tone. Brisk, matter-of-fact. The instruction of someone used to being followed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、値打ち、絶対、教授に、絶対、評価、絶対、いただきたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm hoping the professor will evaluate the paper's contribution fairly. I really appreciate your support.
lines.style: Earnest but not pleading. Steady voice. Careful word choice — he's aware of what he's asking and what's at stake. Slight formality that shows respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会会長の、本気で、絶対、再選、絶対、学界、絶対、ご支持、絶対、いただけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The conference president needs to be re-elected. Get the academic community behind him. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Low, firm authority. Each phrase lands deliberately. Not angry, but unmistakably serious. The tone of someone calling in a favor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、内輪、絶対、の話、絶対、外には、絶対、出しておりません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, I understand. Everything discussed in the lab stays in the lab. Nothing leaves this room.
lines.style: Solemn undertone. Careful delivery — he's making a commitment, not just nodding along. Quiet conviction. The weight of discretion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文に情報、本気で、絶対、詰め込み、絶対、過ぎ、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、絞れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The paper's too dense with information. Cut it down. Be selective — only what's essential.
lines.style: Sharp, instructive. Clipped pace on the direction. Practical, not critical. The feedback of someone who's read too many bloated papers.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外学会、本気で、絶対、関空、絶対、発の、絶対、便、絶対、利用いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, absolutely. I'll be flying out of Kansai for the international conference. Everything's arranged.
lines.style: Confirmation wrapped in courtesy. Efficient, no wasted words. The slight exhale of someone closing one task and moving to the next. Final.
